summary: TLGY Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting an extraordinary general meeting where shareholders approved an amendment to its articles to reduce the monthly extension deposit into the trust account from up to $25,000 to up to $10,000 per month (from $0.05 per share), allowing up to six monthly extensions to complete a business combination. 13,817 Class A shares were redeemed. This is a SPAC extension amendment filing, not a business combination announcement. The filing shows routine SPAC maintenance activity with no target identified. Watch for future announcement of a de-SPAC transaction or potential liquidation if no deal is reached.
